title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Kakariko Village (Young Link Version)
description:
Kakariko Village, a classic of most Legend of Zelda songs



It could fit into some small village/city theme

Now with 3 pitch options!
1 - Original (Set by Default)

2 - Afternoon (Higher Pitch)

3 - Night (Lower Pitch)

Shoutouts to Sariel, for inspiring me into porting this song
